topic.title: Why the visible split says 0.99 and the leaderboard says 0.41: twenty negative results from CASMI26, with controls
topic.forumName: Enveda CASMI 2026 - Molecule ID From Mass Spectra
topic.content:
9.2 The number that should stop you from optimising on the visible split

A competition ships two splits. If the visible one is drawn from the same rows as the provided training data, then a pipeline measured on it is measuring itself.

We can quantify this, and it is not a small effect.

The measurement. We rebuilt one of our own submissions offline — the exact same payloads, replayed through the exact same fusion code, producing a submission.csv that matched our submitted file in 400 of 400 rows. We then scored that file against the answers, which are present in the provided train.parquet because the visible test rows are training rows.
